title: DREAM LOGIC
description:
WHAT IS A LIMINAL SPACE?:
Liminal spaces are those strange, evocative, and occasionally unsettling locations that appear to be the entrance to another realm. When someone enters a space that is outside of typical space and time, they are said to be in a condition of liminality. These people straddle the boundaries set by law, custom, and convention for the typical roles, behaviors, and positions.TRUE DREAMLIKE EXPERIENCE:
• Explore liminal spaces: Pools, School, Hotel, Parking lot, Office and more.

• Fly through real-time generated clouds.

• Outrun other vehicles while driving into the sunset.

• Solve puzzles to advance.
CUSTOM ENTITY MODE:
• Import your own custom entity and try to escape the backrooms.

Importing your own entity has never been easier. Import any picture and sound with just a few clicks.

Features in this game mode:
• Import any picture.
• Import any sound.
• Modify volume of imported sound.
• Modify Player or Entity walk/run speed.
description_short: DREAM LOGIC is a story driven first-person atmospheric horror game which takes place in liminal spaces. Explore various nostalgic, dreamlike, uncanny environments. But don't feel too safe, there's a sneaky creature watching your every move.
